question: The Bihari Puraskar is one of the three literary awards instituted by the ______ in 1991.
solution:
The correct answer is __**KK Birla Foundation.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bihari Puraskar **is a **literary award** instituted by **K. K. Birla Foundation** in **1991.**
 
• The award is **one of the three literary awards** instituted by the K.K. Birla Foundation in 1991**.**
 
• The award is **named after the famous Hindi poet Bihari** and is awarded to an **outstanding work published in Hindi or Rajasthani by a Rajasthani writer in the last 10 years.**
 
• It carries a citation, a plaque, and prize money of Rs. 2.5 lakh.
 
• **Madhu Kankariya** won** 2021 Bihari Puraskar** for her book **'Hum Yahan The'.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Other two literary awards instituted by K.K. Birla Foundation in 1991 are:**

 
 
• **Saraswati Samman** for an **outstanding literary work in any Indian language.**
 
• **Vyas Samman** for **outstanding work in Hindi.**
